visual_direction: Warm illustrated story garden; cream reading paper, indigo primary actions, jade secondary accents and terracotta attention. Keep scene art rich and interface quiet.

global.ruby: Shared WordText; one whole lexical word per ruby, pinyin above its own word, wrap only between words; do not compress Hanzi to fit.
global.contrast: Dark indigo/body text on quiet cream; never long text over patterned scenery. Colour is never the only status signal.
global.motion: Subtle paper-layer translation/opacity; reduced-motion static or opacity only. No endless flashing, parallax that blocks reading, or forced timers in story/conversation.
global.keyboard: All actions focusable, visible focus ring, meaningful reading order; Escape closes overlays and returns focus. No hover-only vocabulary or drag-only game.
global.performance: Use /art manifest WebP/small URLs with intrinsic dimensions. Load current scene/state, preload the next page only, lazy-load catalogue art. Avoid layout shifts during image decode.
global.private_data: No learner uploads, transcripts or raw private source text in public art or scenario files.

reader.desktop: Constrain overall width near 1120px. Illustration and cream caption column can sit side by side with generous gutters; keep caption measure readable and controls near the caption. Preserve one story beat per page.
reader.mobile: Single column. Illustration first, then native ruby caption, then full-width next action above safe-area inset. Do not shrink the desktop spread or embed caption in image. Page counter/back remain reachable without covering art.
reader.art: 3:2 story picture; protect faces and the task-defining object in central safe area. If tall mobile art is needed, request a separately composed image rather than clipping away evidence.
reader.lookup: Tap/focus word opens a bottom sheet on mobile and anchored panel on desktop; closing restores reading position.
reader.failure: Image failure leaves checked text readable and retry available. Unchecked text is withheld.

episode.desktop: One illustrated beat with captions in a quiet adjacent/below panel; controls separate from caption.
episode.mobile: Still plus caption stack with large next/previous buttons. Readable text wins over filling viewport with art.
episode.truthful_media: Label still-image episodes appropriately; do not imply video/audio availability where no playable asset exists. No required autoplay.

game.desktop: Bounded playfield plus persistent instruction and concise goal. Arrow/WASD controls if movement; Enter/Space or numbered alternatives where appropriate.
game.mobile: Instruction in its own cream strip, unclipped playfield below, bottom control zone outside playfield. Large direction/tap controls, no precision dragging requirement, no hover. Keyboard appearance must not hide the instruction or confirm control.
game.language: Targets must differ semantically; remove shape/colour-only shortcuts. Use English setup/tutorial only when designated by product rules; game Chinese passes the same check.
game.pause: Clear held input on blur/visibility change; preserve progress; explicit restart/exit. No invisible timer continuing behind a dialog.
game.acceptance: Run complete start-play-feedback-finish-restart loop with touch and keyboard; readiness event alone is insufficient.

conversation.desktop: Character portrait beside constrained conversation column; message text and answers remain readable.
conversation.mobile: Small portrait/header above transcript, input with tone controls and send button above keyboard/safe area. Transcript scrolls independently without jumping after audio changes.
conversation.alternatives: Typed path always works; voice has explicit start/end and permission/failure fallback. Hints and retry do not delete draft answer.

room_and_town.desktop: Preserve source aspect ratios and layout coordinates; concise labels on objects, full accessible action list below. Keep state markers clear of faces and relevant objects.
room_and_town.mobile: Whole home room visible plus actions below; town may pan horizontally, initially centred on home, with equivalent place list. Do not force tiny labels to carry the only navigation.
room_and_town.personalization: Persist chosen objects/positions separately from backdrop; do not bake ownership or learner text into scene art.

acceptance_checklist: All five viewports with actual longest Mandarin/ruby strings and long English names
200% text zoom without clipped CTA or lost caption
Loading, empty, vocabulary locked, pending, failed/retry, ready/unseen and completed states
No hidden overlap between caption, art, input keyboard and safe-area controls
At least one screenshot per implemented pack surface on desktop and mobile, followed by full interaction loop
